name: P1 (corneal reflection)
user: The first Purkinje image: the bright reflection of the light on the front of the cornea. With P4, it gives the eye's rotation in a dual Purkinje (DPI) tracker.
developer: Centroid of the spot's brightness above the P1 threshold, in a square around its rough position, on the smoothed image (DPI-SPEC 2, 4). Image coordinates, pixel centers at integers (SPEC 9.1). Status failed when no spot at least min_diameter across is found. Method: Ryan Ressmeyer's OpenIrisDPI.

fields.name: P1 size
fields.help: Diameter of the spot: √(major × minor) of its moment ellipse, each axis 4√λ of the brightness-weighted second moments. A uniform disk's diameter; 4σ for a Gaussian spot.
